name: dead-expressions
title: Diagnostic: dead expressions
summary: Deliberately flawed: a static card that commits a chain of three expressions (inset, padded, third) whose result nothing reads, so the audit reports dead_code listing the three FloatExpression operations.
prompt: A chain of three committed expressions whose result nothing reads.
teaches: Recognise dead_code: expressions forced into the document (commit: true) that no draw, layout or output reads
Fix it by deleting the chain, or by dropping commit so the converter only writes variables something uses
Size a canvas card from componentWidth()/componentHeight() so it stretches with the document

snippets.note: the flaw: inset = density() * 4, committed though nothing reads it
the end of the dead chain

check.describe: audit reports dead_code with ops 7, 8 and 9 (three FloatExpression), plus the matching unused_variables info; the card renders normally. Resized, the background fills the box and the card stretches to the width with 30 dp margins, centred vertically; the three dead variables are unchanged.

pitfalls: Without "commit": true, a variable nothing reads is never written at all (both the Java parser and json2rc defer variables until first use), so the dead chain only exists when it is committed
